DATA VER TYPE /CPD/FVER.

DATA FVER TYPE /CPD/FVER.
DATATVER TYPE /CPD/FVER.

TVER = VARV('CPD_V_VERSION').
FVER= VARV('CPD_V_VER').


FOREACH VER IN REFDATA.

 IF VER= FVER.
*  Copy CR Data from Current Version to Target Version (CB or DB)
*  Copy CR Quantity
   {/CPD/FQTY, TVER} ={/CPD/FQTY, FVER}.
*  Copy CR Cost
   {/CPD/FPCA, TVER} ={/CPD/FPCA, FVER}.
   {/CPD/FTCA, TVER} = {/CPD/FTCA, FVER}.
*  Copy CR Revenue
   {/CPD/FPSR, TVER} = {/CPD/FPSR, FVER}.
   {/CPD/FTSR, TVER} = {/CPD/FTSR, FVER}.
****  Market Cost KFs are discontinued - User Story 6775043
****  Copy CR Market Cost
***   {ZCPDFPCAT, TVER} = {ZCPDFPCAT, FVER}.
***   {ZCPDFTCAT, TVER} = {ZCPDFTCAT, FVER}.
*  Copy CRProposed Quantity, Cost and Revenue
   {ZFPROPQTY, TVER} ={ZFPROPQTY, FVER}.
   {ZFPROPCST, TVER} = {ZFPROPCST, FVER}.
   {ZFPROPREV, TVER} = {ZFPROPREV, FVER}.
*  Recalculate CR Cost Rate and Revenue Rate
   {'/CPD/FTRATE',TVER} = {/CPD/FTCA, TVER} / {/CPD/FQTY, TVER}.
   {'/CPD/FTSRRATE',TVER} = {/CPD/FTSR, TVER} / {/CPD/FQTY, TVER}.
  ENDIF.
ENDFOR.

DATA CRAID TYPE /CPD/CRAID.
DATA CRID TYPE /CPD/CRID.

DATA CRAID2 TYPE /CPD/CRAID.
DATA CRID2 TYPE /CPD/CRID.

CRAID2 = VARV('/CPD/S_CHNG_ALT').
CRID2 = VARV('/CPD/PFP_CHANGE_REQ_ID').


FOREACH CRAID, CRID IN REFDATA.

 IF CRAID = CRAID2 AND CRID = CRID2.
* Add CR Data within Target version to Not Assigned CR Data
*   Add CR Quantity
   {/CPD/FQTY, #, #} = {/CPD/FQTY, #, #} + {/CPD/FQTY, CRAID2, CRID2}.
*   Add CR Cost
   {/CPD/FPCA, #, #} = {/CPD/FPCA, #,#} + {/CPD/FPCA, CRAID2, CRID2}.
   {/CPD/FTCA, #, #} = {/CPD/FTCA, #, #} + {/CPD/FTCA, CRAID2, CRID2}.
*   Add CR Revenue
   {/CPD/FPSR, #, #} = {/CPD/FPSR, #, #} + {/CPD/FPSR,CRAID2, CRID2}.
   {/CPD/FTSR, #, #} = {/CPD/FTSR, #, #} +{/CPD/FTSR, CRAID2, CRID2}.
*   Add CR Market Cost
   {ZCPDFPCAT, #, #} = {ZCPDFPCAT, #, #} + {ZCPDFPCAT, CRAID2, CRID2}.
   {ZCPDFTCAT, #, #} = {ZCPDFTCAT, #, #} + {ZCPDFTCAT,CRAID2, CRID2}.
*   Add CR Proposed Quantity, Cost and Revenue
   {ZFPROPQTY, #, #} = {ZFPROPQTY, #, #} + {ZFPROPQTY,CRAID2, CRID2}.
   {ZFPROPCST, #, #} = {ZFPROPCST, #, #} +{ZFPROPCST, CRAID2, CRID2}.
   {ZFPROPREV, #, #} = {ZFPROPREV, #, #} + {ZFPROPREV, CRAID2, CRID2}.
*   Recalculate Plan Cost Rate and Revenue Rate
   {'/CPD/FTRATE',#, #} = {/CPD/FTCA, #, #} / {/CPD/FQTY, #, #}.
   {'/CPD/FTSRRATE',#,#} = {/CPD/FTSR, #, #} / {/CPD/FQTY, #, #}.

  ENDIF.
ENDFOR.

DATA CRID2 TYPE /CPD/CRID.

DATA ZRLO2 TYPE ZRESLOC.
DATA ZRID2 TYPE ZRITEMID.

DATA CR_FUOM TYPE /CPD/FUOM.

DATA CST TYPE F.

CRAID2 = VARV( '/CPD/S_CHNG_ALT' ).
CRID2 = VARV( '/CPD/PFP_CHANGE_REQ_ID' ).

CR_FRTYP = OBJV( ).CR_FUOM = OBJV( ).

QTY = 0.
CST = 0.
FLAG = 0.
REMQTY = 0.
REMCST = 0.

*BREAK-POINT.

FOREACH CRAID, CRID,FRES, FPER, ZBPA, POIT, PORD, ZRLO, ZRID IN REFDATA.
  IFCRAID = CRAID2 AND CRID = CRID2.
    CRAID2 = CRAID.
    CRID2 = CRID.
    FRES2 = FRES.
    ZBPA2 = ZBPA.
    POIT2 = POIT.
    PORD2 = PORD.
    ZRLO2 = ZRLO.
    ZRID2 =ZRID.

    QTY = QTY + { /CPD/FQTY, CRAID2, CRID2, FRES2, FPER, ZBPA2, POIT2, PORD2, ZRLO2, ZRID2 }.
    CST = CST + { /CPD/FTCA, CRAID2, CRID2, FRES2, FPER, ZBPA2, POIT2, PORD2, ZRLO2, ZRID2 }.
    FLAG = 1.
  ENDIF.
ENDFOR.

IF FLAG =1.
* Flag 1 means there is CR Data available

  IF ( CR_FRTYP = '0ACT' AND CR_FUOM = 'H' ) OR ( CR_FRTYP = 'ZEXS' AND CR_FUOM = 'H' ) OR ( CR_FRTYP = 'ZUNI' AND CR_FUOM = 'EA').
*   Quantity is the CR driver for Labor and UnitsIF QTY <> 0.
*  Scenario 1: CR QTY <> 0 AND CR char and CFP char are in alignment.  change the quantity.  Most commonscenario.
      FOREACH CRAID, CRID, FRES, FPER, ZBPA, POIT, PORD, ZRLO, ZRID IN REFDATA.
        IF ZBPA = '0000000000'.
          IF FRES = FRES2 AND ZRLO = ZRLO2.IF CRAID = CRAID2 AND CRID = CRID2.
*   Copy Plan Quantity
                 { /CPD/FQTY, #, #, FRES, FPER, ZBPA, POIT, PORD, ZRLO, ZRID } =
                 { /CPD/FQTY, #, #,FRES, FPER, ZBPA, POIT, PORD, ZRLO, ZRID } +{ /CPD/FQTY, CRAID2, CRID2, FRES2, FPER, ZBPA2, POIT2, PORD2, ZRLO2, ZRID2 }.

              IF CR_FRTYP = 'ZEXS'.{ /CPD/FTRATE, #, #, FRES, FPER, ZBPA, POIT, PORD, ZRLO, ZRID } =
                 { /CPD/FTRATE, CRAID2, CRID2, FRES2,FPER, ZBPA2, POIT2, PORD2, ZRLO2, ZRID2 }.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
*  Scenario 2: CR QTY <> 0 AND CRchar and CFP char are NOT in alignment.  change the quantity and realign the characteristics
          ELSEIF FRES <>FRES2 OR ZRLO <> ZRLO2.
            IF CRAID = CRAID2 AND CRID = CRID2.
*   Copy Plan Quantity
              { /CPD/FQTY, #, #, FRES, FPER, ZBPA, POIT, PORD, ZRLO, ZRID } ={ /CPD/FQTY, CRAID2, CRID2, FRES2, FPER, ZBPA2, POIT2, PORD2, ZRLO2, ZRID2 }.
